SERVICE

Paint Correction

Reduce swirl marks, light scratches, and paint imperfections to restore gloss.

Overview

A professional polishing process designed to reduce paint defects and bring back a cleaner, smoother appearance.

Over time, your vehicle’s paint can develop swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation, and other imperfections caused by washing, weather, and daily use.

Paint Correction at HyperAuto Care uses professional polishing techniques to carefully improve the paint surface and restore a better finish.

Each vehicle is inspected before service to determine the right correction level based on the condition of the paint.

Service Process

Our Paint Correction Process At HyperAuto Care

Step 01
Paint Assessment

We inspect the paint and determine the correction level needed.

Step 02
Surface Preparation

The vehicle is cleaned and prepared before polishing.

Step 03
Paint Correction

We carefully polish the surface to improve clarity and reduce imperfections.

Step 04
Final Inspection

We review the finished paint and discuss recommended maintenance options.

Why Choose HyperAuto Care For Paint Correction

Professional paint correction helps restore the look of your vehicle and improve its overall finish.

Remove Paint Imperfections

Reduce visible swirl marks, light scratches, and surface defects caused by daily use.

Restore Paint Clarity

Bring back a cleaner and smoother appearance to your vehicle’s paint.

Improve Vehicle Appearance

Make your vehicle look refreshed without repainting the surface.

Prepare For Paint Protection

Create a better surface before applying ceramic coating or other protection services.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about restoring your vehicle’s paint condition.

Does paint correction remove all scratches?

How long does paint correction take?

Should I apply ceramic coating after paint correction?

Is paint correction safe?
